name: Borosil Renewables Ltd
title: Borosil Renewables Ltd - 502219 - Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Analyst / Investor Meet - Outcome

read.thesis: Solar glass pricing near peak at ~INR150/mm with supply gap; new 600 TPD furnaces targeted in FY27 (+60% capacity), but Q4 sales flattered by Ind AS timing and management guides run-rate ~INR400-410 cr/quarter.

utilisation.quote: We did not curtail production and have been able to maintain full production throughout.

capex.peers_comment: Management expects about 33 GW of solar glass capacity by multiple companies, mostly captive, by March 2027, taking domestic capacity to 51 GW against demand of about 65 GW.
capex.quote: we expect solar glass capacities of about 33 gigawatts by multiple companies, majority of which is for captive consumption to be commissioned by March 2027

triggers.label: Capacity +60% (600 TPD) in FY27
triggers.quote: we are well on way to set up new production of 300 tons per day 2 furnaces. So that is 600 tons per day, which we hope to see in production within this financial year.

triggers.label: Realisation ~INR150/mm, near peak
triggers.quote: We are already at almost peak of the pricing.

triggers.label: Indonesia entry, price pressure seen as limited
triggers.quote: their glass has come into the market. So far, it has not made any very great impact.

triggers.label: Q4 sales lifted by Ind AS timing (~6%)
triggers.quote: about 6% of the sales impact in Q4 is on account of Ind AS impact and that has exhausted.

triggers.label: Run-rate sales INR400-410 cr/quarter
triggers.quote: INR400 crores, INR410 crores is a good amount to look at.

guidance.quote: we already said 30% to 33% margin is something what we consider achievable, barring any unforeseen circumstances.
we might be aiming for about INR75 crores sales for the first year, which is very modest.

guidance.value: 600 TPD (2 x 300 TPD) within FY27; first furnace Jan 2027
guidance.quote: we hope to see in production within this financial year. And that could increase our production capacity by 60%

guidance.value: INR950 crores capitalised in current financial year
guidance.quote: INR950 crores capitalization we'll be doing in the current financial year.

red_flags.label: Q4 sales flattered by Ind AS timing
red_flags.quote: about 6% of the sales impact in Q4 is on account of Ind AS impact and that has exhausted.

red_flags.label: Germany subsidiary written off; tax credit boosts PBT
red_flags.quote: the company in its books of accounts for the financial year ended 31 March, 2026 has written off the above exposure in Geosphere and GMB.

evasions.quote: Probably Q2 con call, we'll have a better -- we'll have a closer picture at that time.
we'll have to see how it goes.
